- Files: a folder of thousands of files opens in pages of 300 (back / forward under the list), so a big folder such as Camera no longer crashes.
- Files: long press a row, then slide the finger over the others to pick them all; a long press further down picks the whole range between the two.
- Files: video thumbnails are made one at a time and small, so a folder of many clips no longer runs out of memory.
- Windows 11: the extra apps (Notes and the other tools) use a see-through, blurred window in the Windows 11 look.
- Notes: the bar and its pen menu are smaller; the new-note button is a small black round button with a white plus.
